nodes.summary: Dispatch matrix loader reads § C3, validates skills/experts/predicates/model_per_expert pairing, fail-fast on any violation
Convergence engine implements parallel-then-merge (with expert_slug provenance + co_reporters + stable sort), sequential-lens (immutable LensDelta), structured-disagreement (ConflictPair output)
Schema validator extracts YAML jsonschema from SKILL.md; raises SchemaValidationError on parse/compile failure, returns ValidationFailure on payload validation failure; zero I/O side effects
Predicate registry: named callable registry, always_true/false built-ins, immutable after evaluate, MatrixRow.predicate='none' coerces to None
Zero credential/network access; two allowed file-path categories only
Typed exceptions with detail + context; zero stdout/stderr writes
Loader fail-fast; validator idempotent; registry immutable after evaluate
Structured error fields on all exception types for operator diagnostic routing
N/A — headless pure-Python library with no UI surface

Dispatch matrix loader: six sub-cases — fabricated skill, fabricated expert blueprint slug, extension allowlist acceptance, live canonical C3 step-set, model_per_expert routing-key pairing, missing-routing-key fail

Convergence engine: three modes — parallel_then_merge with expert_slug provenance + co_reporters + stable sort + findings list, sequential_lens immutability, structured_disagreement ConflictPair shape
Schema validator: schema-block-missing raises, payload validation returns ValidationFailure, success returns ValidationSuccess, no stdout/stderr/file write
Predicate registry: always_true, always_false, predicate=none coercion, load-time registry hit accepted, load-time registry miss raises DispatchMatrixError
Pydantic v2 model: step, skill, expert_panel, convergence_mode, model_per_expert, lead_voice, predicate
Pydantic v2 model: category, summary, evidence_ref, severity, expert_slug (added by merger), co_reporters (populated by merger during dedup)
Pydantic v2 model conforming to ADR-364 § 6: expert_slug_blueprint XOR expert_slug_extension, verdict, findings
Pydantic v2 model: aggregate_verdict, findings (deduped + escalated + sorted), findings_before_dedup, findings_after_dedup, severity_escalation_events
Pydantic v2 model: prior_findings cumulative accumulator passed read-only between sequential-lens callables
Pydantic v2 model: expert_a (lex-lower), expert_b (lex-higher), category
Pydantic v2 model: verdicts, conflict_pairs, severity_escalation_events (conflict-induced only)
Pydantic v2 model with extra=allow: changed_paths, has_user_facing_flow, plus consumer-extensible fields
